episodeTitle.en: Bending the universe in your favor | Claire Vo (LaunchDarkly, Color, Optimizely, ChatPRD)

guestBioOfficial.en: Claire Vo is the chief product officer at LaunchDarkly and the founder of ChatPRD, likely the most popular PM-specific AI product out there. Before LaunchDarkly, she was a longtime chief product officer at Color and Optimizely. Claire has founded and managed two other companies, Pretty HQ and Experiment Engine, the latter of which Optimizely acquired in 2017. In our conversation, we discuss: • Knowing what you want in your career and being clear about it
guestBioOfficial.zh:
克莱尔·沃（Claire Vo）是LaunchDarkly的首席产品官，也是ChatPRD的创始人。ChatPRD可能是目前最受PM群体欢迎的AI产品。在加入LaunchDarkly之前，她曾长期担任Color和Optimizely的首席产品官。克莱尔还创立并管理过两家其他公司——Pretty HQ和Experiment Engine，后者于2017年被Optimizely收购。在我们的对话中，我们探讨了以下内容：
• 明确自己的职业发展方向

title.en: Bending the universe in your favor | Claire Vo (LaunchDarkly, Color, Optimizely, ChatPRD)

summary.en: Claire describes going from an eight-hour setup disaster (that deleted her family calendar) to running eight different personal agents that save real economic value, like “Sam” who does sales work she used to pay someone for. She argues the unlock is running multiple specialized agents and pulling the thread long enough to see where the tools are heading. The conversation is a first-hand tour of living with AI agents in daily life.
summary.zh: Claire 描述了自己从一次耗时八小时、还误删家庭日历的糟糕安装，到运行八个不同个人智能体、产生真实经济价值的历程，比如替她做销售工作的“Sam”（以前她每周付费请人做）。她认为关键在于运行多个专业化智能体，并持续拉线足够久以看见工具走向。对话是关于在日常生活中与 AI 智能体共处的一手之旅。
